soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed convergence of conventional studentization is not well-defined: the conventional HAC standard error has no specified kernel, bandwidth, fitted-score construction, or bandwidth conditions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3.1, Assumption 4 and Theorem 2; Section 3 inference discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Assumption 4 requires pre-determined supplemental proxies, and Theorem 2 identifies donor weights through their proxy moment; the paper’s inference is for a pre-specified construction.
The paper provides explicit finite-sample coverage formulas for post-model-selection intervals in its nested-model preliminary-test setting.

The paper establishes asymptotic sample-splitting validity for weakly dependent time series under beta-mixing or tau-dependence conditions, while leaving target-specific second-block inference to further analysis.

The article’s numbered main asymptotic-normality result is Theorem 3 for its GMM estimator; its abstract and Section 1.2 describe consistency and asymptotic normality under correct specification of at least one bridge model.

Replace the Qiu et al. Theorems 7--8 locator with the published Theorem 3 and distinguish its doubly robust GMM result from the proposal’s square fixed-role bridge expansion.

Add a rectangular or simplex-constrained corollary, or a precise transfer theorem from the square two-role construction to a published synthetic-control role menu, to make the West-German consumer operational rather than redesign-only.
